title: Ensure verification of signed commits for new changes before merging
description: Git commit authorship is self-asserted: anyone who can push can claim to be anyone. Verifying signatures at the server is what makes the audit trail mean something.
remediation: Bitbucket Data Center has no built-in signature check, so install a hook add-on that verifies GPG or SSH signatures (Atlassian Marketplace, e.g. a "commit signature verification" pre-receive hook), then enable it at Repository settings -> Hooks. Once installed, add its plugin key to scm-bench's signatureHookKeys config so this check recognises it.
remediationZh: Bitbucket DC 无内置签名校验，需从 Atlassian Marketplace 安装可验证 GPG/SSH 签名的 pre-receive hook 插件，然后在 仓库设置 -> Hooks 中启用。安装后请把该插件 key 加入 scm-bench 配置的 signatureHookKeys，本规则才能识别它。
